# Tiger Data Documentation

Over 3 million Tiger Data databases power customer-facing applications. Speed without sacrifice for real-time analytics, time series, and vector workloads. Creators of TimescaleDB.

Tiger Cloud is the modern Postgres data platform for all your applications. It enhances Postgres to handle time series, events, real-time analytics, and vector search—all in a single database alongside transactional workloads.

You get one system that handles live data ingestion, late and out-of-order updates, and low latency queries, with the performance, reliability, and scalability your app needs. Ideal for IoT, crypto, finance, SaaS, and a myriad other domains, Tiger Cloud allows you to build data-heavy, mission-critical apps while retaining the familiarity and reliability of PostgreSQL.

This repository contains the complete documentation for Tiger Data products available at https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/.

## Getting Started

- [Get started overview](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/getting-started/latest/): Introduction to Tiger Data products and services
- [Create a Tiger Cloud service](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/getting-started/latest/services/): Learn about Tiger Cloud capabilities and create your first service
- [Run queries from Tiger Console](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/getting-started/latest/run-queries-from-console/): Use the SQL editor and SQL Assistant in Tiger Cloud
- [Try key Tiger Data features](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/getting-started/latest/try-key-features-timescale-products/): Explore hypertables, time buckets, compression, and continuous aggregates
- [Start coding with Tiger Data](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/getting-started/latest/start-coding-with-timescale/): Connect and code with your preferred programming language

## Core Features and Functionality

- [Unique indexes on hypertables](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/use-timescale/latest/hypertables/hypertables-and-unique-indexes/): Handling unique constraints

### Hypercore (Columnar Storage)
- [Hypercore overview](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/use-timescale/latest/hypercore/): Advanced columnar storage for real-time analytics
- [Real-time analytics in Hypercore](https://www.tigerdata.com/docs/use-timescale/latest/hypercore/real-time-analytics-in-hypercore/): High-performance analytics capabilities

## Contributing

To contribute to this documentation:
1. Fork or clone the repository
2. Create a branch from `latest`
3. Make your changes following the style guide in CONTRIBUTING.md
4. Submit a pull request back to `latest`
5. Sign the Contributor License Agreement (CLA) if this is your first contribution

The documentation is built using Gatsby framework and automatically generates preview links for pull requests.
